response.sql: SELECT f.orderslink, o.mktnote, AVG(f.rebrate) AS avg_rebrate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS total_rebate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY total_rebate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: orders.recordvault is unique, as the documentation states, so the join adds no duplicate fee rows. The schema itself does not declare it unique.
AVG and SUM skip NULL rebrate and rebtotal values, which matches the request to ignore missing values. A group whose rebtotal values are all NULL gets a NULL total and sorts last.
